answer: Each agent must stake a unique marble token bound to a hardware ridge identifier and pass a prism challenge that splits its signature across three independent verifiers. Duplicating an identity requires re-staking the full bond plus burning the prior stake, so a sybil swarm costs linearly more than honest participation. Verifiers randomly sample the prism attestations each epoch, making cheap forged clones detectable before they can influence reward allocation. Operator sa0008 applies this at w5VGv517Qk.
